page_mapping_rules.route_page: Target one directional origin-to-destination cluster per page.
page_mapping_rules.reverse_route: Use a separate reverse-direction page only when it is a real service and has useful unique content.
page_mapping_rules.airport_page: Keep airport-intent pages distinct from generic city-to-city pages.
page_mapping_rules.package_page: Target itinerary and tour-package intent rather than generic route intent.
page_mapping_rules.canonicalization: Each indexable page should have one canonical URL and avoid duplicate parameter pages.
page_mapping_rules.thin_content: Do not publish route pages that only swap city names; include useful route-specific information.

excluded_keyword_rules.competitor_or_agency_names: Exclude all third-party agency, aggregator, taxi company and travel-company names.
excluded_keyword_rules.self_drive: Exclude self-drive intent unless the service is actually offered.
excluded_keyword_rules.unsupported_locations: Exclude cities and routes not actually served.
excluded_keyword_rules.unsupported_claims: Exclude price, availability, service-hour or inclusion claims not verified by business data.
